briefdescription.para: Check TrustZone security access for a device request.

detaileddescription.para: Validates whether a device request is permitted based on the device's TrustZone security attributes and the caller's requested capabilities.

Policy axes: SlaveTz - security of the device's MMIO register space (who can program the device's configuration registers) MasterTz - whether PM_CAP_SECURE is requested, i.e. whether the device's bus-master port should emit secure AXI transactions CmdType - whether the PM API call arrived via a secure or non-secure IPI

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the requirement structure
Requested capabilities bitmask
Command type (secure or non-secure)

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if access is allowed, XPM_PM_NO_ACCESS otherwise

briefdescription.para: Look up a runtime operations record by device identifier.
